post_reselection_tracking.semantics: The exact confirmation record starts the sustained interval. Recording order, not a float-time window, selects later records; equal-time or backdated later faults remain evidence. Receive /clock values must be valid and nondecreasing. Derived max(header, receive) time regressions are diagnostic because measurement and prediction headers have different meanings. A brief confirmation cannot certify sustained tracking

flight_acceptance.scope: Observed flight/occlusion behavior only; no ground-truth accuracy threshold is asserted
